text: Over the last 30 days, several visitors noted issues with crowding, making it difficult to fully experience the exhibits despite timed entry tickets. Some found the reliance on AI for interactive elements detracted from their visit, and a few missed sections due to unclear signage or lack of directional markers. Problems with parking were mentioned, particularly related to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces. Additionally, there was confusion about ticket purchasing, as tickets must be bought online in advance and cannot be purchased on-site, which caused inconvenience for some visitors. The gift shop received criticism for limited options representing the library.
